stories.title: China’s Xi shares a rare laugh on White House tour at Trump’s Biden autopen joke

en.title: China's Xi shares a rare laugh on White House tour at Trump's Biden autopen joke
en.summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping laughed while touring the White House as Donald Trump showed him a framed autopen displayed where Joe Biden's portrait normally hangs. The moment was notable given Xi's typically reserved demeanor during his first US state visit in over a decade.

stories.title: How was dinner? Takeaways from Xi and Trump’s evening at the White House

en.title: How was dinner? Takeaways from Xi and Trump's evening at the White House
en.summary: Presidents Xi Jinping and Donald Trump held their second face-to-face meeting this year, addressing American business executives and officials before a state dinner. The leaders discussed cooperation and issues including Taiwan and the Middle East.

en.summary: A White House state dinner for Xi Jinping and Donald Trump featured a menu combining American ingredients with subtle Chinese influences. Xi wore a Zhongshan suit while attending the event with business leaders and government officials.

stories.title: Shanghai Gold Exchange pushes more Chinese banks to end retail leverage trading

en.title: Shanghai Gold Exchange pushes more Chinese banks to end retail leverage trading
en.summary: At least a dozen Chinese banks, including the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China, plan to wind down retail leveraged precious-metals trading where individual investors use margin deposits to speculate on gold and silver contracts. The Shanghai Gold Exchange mandated these withdrawals amid volatile international gold prices.

stories.title: Hong Kong catching up with Dubai in ‘super-prime’ property sales amid Iran war

en.title: Hong Kong catching up with Dubai in 'super-prime' property sales amid Iran war
en.summary: Hong Kong has significantly reduced Dubai's lead in ultra-luxury residential property sales, with Dubai recording 131 super-prime deals worth US$2.17 billion in the second quarter but experiencing a 27 percent decline from the previous quarter. Rising Middle Eastern conflict is affecting Dubai's market activity.

stories.title: China’s EV and battery makers tussle over paying resumed lithium-ion tax: sources

en.title: China's EV and battery makers tussle over paying resumed lithium-ion tax: sources
en.summary: Chinese electric vehicle makers and battery manufacturers are negotiating over who should pay a resumed consumption tax on lithium-ion batteries after an 11-year exemption ends. The tax, partially restored at 2 percent in September, will return to its full rate in one year.

stories.title: Blue Bottle bets that Chinese consumers will drink more premium coffee

en.title: Blue Bottle bets that Chinese consumers will drink more premium coffee
en.summary: US premium coffee brand Blue Bottle Coffee plans to open its first Beijing store in the capital's central business district at China World Mall, targeting China's growing premium coffee market. The shop is expected to open by year-end.

stories.title: The Live Conversation: family wealth enters new era

en.title: The Live Conversation: family wealth enters new era
en.summary: Hong Kong is positioning itself as a leading Asian center for family wealth management and succession planning. Industry regulators, family leaders, and advisers convened at a conference to discuss how inherited wealth can be managed and transformed into sustainable enterprises.
